(define (reynolds-boid self neighbors)
  (let* ((n (length neighbors))
         (avg-x (if (= n 0) 0 (/ (apply + (map car neighbors)) n)))
         (avg-y (if (= n 0) 0 (/ (apply + (map cadr neighbors)) n)))
         (sep-x (apply + (map (lambda (p) (- (car self) (car p))) neighbors)))
         (sep-y (apply + (map (lambda (p) (- (cadr self) (cadr p))) neighbors)))
         (coh-x (- avg-x (car self))) (coh-y (- avg-y (cadr self))))
    (list 'sep (list sep-x sep-y) 'coh (list coh-x coh-y) 'align 'from-headings)))
(display (reynolds-boid '(0 0) '((5 0) (0 5) (-5 0))))

(define (animate-spin id frames target-spin)
  (define (spin-frame ctx)
    (let ((current-spin (or (entity/ref id '__spin) 0))
          (progress (/ (ctx-get ctx 'frame-count) frames)))
      (entity/pose! id (* target-spin progress) 1 1)
      (if (>= progress 1.0)
        (next 'done ctx)
        (next 'spin-frame ctx))))
  (spin-frame (ctx-set 'frame-count 0 (ctx-new))))

      (set! angle (modulo (+ angle step) 360))
      (entity/rotate! id angle)))))

(define (projectile-arc v0 angle-rad g t)
  ;; Real projectile motion: y(t) = v0·sin(θ)·t − ½g·t²
  (- (* v0 (sin angle-rad) t) (* 0.5 g t t)))
(define g 9.81)
(define samples (map (lambda (t) (projectile-arc 20 0.785398 g t)) '(0 0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0)))
;; Peak at t = v0·sin(θ)/g ≈ 20·0.707/9.81 ≈ 1.44s. Endpoints ≈ 0.
(and (< (abs (car samples)) 0.01) (> (list-ref samples 2) (car samples)))

(define (free-fall-y y0 v0 g t)
  ;; Kinematics: y(t) = y0 + v0·t − ½g·t². Free-fall from y0=100 with v0=0.
  (- (+ y0 (* v0 t)) (* 0.5 g t t)))
(define g 9.81)
(define positions (map (lambda (t) (free-fall-y 100 0 g t)) '(0 0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0)))
;; Ground contact at t = sqrt(2·y0/g) = sqrt(200/9.81) ≈ 4.52s. Monotone decrease.
(and (= (car positions) 100)
     (< (cadr positions) (car positions))
     (< (caddr positions) (cadr positions)))

(define (bow-angle-at t hold peak)
  ;; Sinusoidal down-and-up on sagittal pivot: θ(t) = peak · sin(π · t/hold).
  (* peak (sin (* 3.14159 (/ t hold)))))

(define samples (map (lambda (t) (bow-angle-at t 1.0 peak)) '(0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1.0)))
;; Endpoints ≈ 0, midpoint = peak.
(and (< (abs (car samples)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (car (reverse samples))) 0.001)
     (> (list-ref samples 2) 1.0))

(define (hooke-oscillation t period amp)
  ;; Simple harmonic on scale: s(t) = 1 + amp·sin(2π·t/period). Hooke's law form.
  (+ 1.0 (* amp (sin (* 6.28318 (/ t period))))))
(define samples (map (lambda (t) (hooke-oscillation t 2.0 0.05)) '(0 0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0)))
;; Bounded around 1.0 ± amp; period returns to start.
(and (< (abs (- (car samples) 1.0)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (- (car (reverse samples)) 1.0)) 0.001)
     (> (cadr samples) 1.0))

(define (rotation-matrix-x cos-t sin-t v)
  ;; 2D rotation of body-vector by angle θ: R(θ)·v where R = [[cos -sin][sin cos]].
  (let ((x (car v)) (y (cadr v)))
    (list (- (* cos-t x) (* sin-t y))
          (+ (* sin-t x) (* cos-t y)))))
(define c (cos 0.436)) ; 25° in radians ≈ 0.436
(define s (sin 0.436))
(define v-rest '(0 1)) ; upright torso vector

;; Leaned vector: rotated by 25° — magnitude preserved.

(and (< (abs angle-east) 0.001)

(define (arctan-symmetric x1 y1 x2 y2)
  ;; look(a→b) angle + look(b→a) angle should differ by π (opposite directions).
  (let ((ab (atan (- y2 y1) (- x2 x1)))
        (ba (atan (- y1 y2) (- x1 x2))))
    (< (abs (- (abs (- ab ba)) 3.14159)) 0.001)))

(define (angular-descent theta-up t hold)
  ;; Linear descent from θ_up to 0 over hold-time: θ(t) = θ_up · (1 − t/hold).
  (max 0 (* theta-up (- 1 (/ t hold)))))
(define descent (map (lambda (t) (angular-descent 1.57 t 1.0)) '(0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1.0)))
;; Monotone decrease, endpoint 0.
(and (> (car descent) 1.5)
     (< (car (reverse descent)) 0.001)
     (> (car descent) (cadr descent)))

(define (damped-nod t amp T damping)
  ;; Damped angular sinusoid: θ(t) = amp · e^(−damping·t) · sin(2π·t/T).
  (* amp (exp (- (* damping t))) (sin (* 6.28318 (/ t T)))))
(define samples (map (lambda (t) (damped-nod t 0.3 1.0 0.5)) '(0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1.0)))
;; Endpoint decays; midpoint sinusoidal.
(and (< (abs (car samples)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (car (reverse samples))) 0.4))

(define (damped-nod t amp T damping)
  (* amp (exp (- (* damping t))) (sin (* 6.28318 (/ t T)))))
;; Each pulse decays independently — three pulses sum without interference (superposition).
(define (three-pulse-sum t)
  (+ (damped-nod t 0.3 1.0 0.5)
     (damped-nod (max 0 (- t 1.0)) 0.3 1.0 0.5)
     (damped-nod (max 0 (- t 2.0)) 0.3 1.0 0.5)))
(> (three-pulse-sum 0.25) 0)

(define (unit-vector-to-target x1 y1 x2 y2)
  ;; Direction vector: normalize (Δx, Δy) to length 1.
  (let* ((dx (- x2 x1)) (dy (- y2 y1))
         (len (sqrt (+ (* dx dx) (* dy dy)))))
    (if (= len 0) '(0 0)
        (list (/ dx len) (/ dy len)))))
(define u (unit-vector-to-target 0 0 3 4))
;; Pythagoras 3-4-5: unit vector is (3/5, 4/5). Magnitude = 1.
(and (< (abs (- (car u) 0.6)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (- (cadr u) 0.8)) 0.001))

(define (angle-to-raised t hold theta-up)
  ;; Linear rise to θ_up: θ(t) = θ_up · (t/hold), clamped.
  (min theta-up (* theta-up (/ t hold))))

     (< (abs (- (car (reverse rise)) 1.57)) 0.001)

    (min dist arm-max)))

(define (gait-phase leg t T)
  ;; Bipedal gait: left leg = sin(2π·t/T), right leg = sin(2π·t/T + π).
  ;; Phases are 180° offset — one always contact, one always swing.
  (case leg
    ((left)  (sin (* 6.28318 (/ t T))))
    ((right) (sin (+ (* 6.28318 (/ t T)) 3.14159)))))
(define t 0.25) (define T 1.0)
(define left  (gait-phase 'left  t T))
(define right (gait-phase 'right t T))
;; Phase-shift by π: left + right ≈ 0 for pure sinusoids.

(define (pendulum-small-angle t T amp)
  ;; Small-angle pendulum ODE: θ¨ + (g/L)·θ = 0 has solution θ(t) = amp·cos(√(g/L)·t)
  ;; With T = 2π/ω, ω = √(g/L). For our sway period T:
  (* amp (cos (* 6.28318 (/ t T)))))
(define samples (map (lambda (t) (pendulum-small-angle t 2.0 0.087)) '(0 0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0)))
;; Period T=2: at t=0 and t=2 the angle equals +amp; at t=1 it equals −amp.
(and (< (abs (- (car samples) 0.087)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (- (list-ref samples 2) -0.087)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (- (car (reverse samples)) 0.087)) 0.001))

(define (yaw-rotation-so2 theta v)
  ;; SO(2) yaw rotation: apply rotation matrix R(θ) to facing-vector.
  (let ((x (car v)) (y (cadr v)))
    (list (- (* (cos theta) x) (* (sin theta) y))
          (+ (* (sin theta) x) (* (cos theta) y)))))
(define facing-east '(1 0))

     (< (abs (- (cadr after-90) 1)) 0.001)
     (< (abs (- (car after-180) -1)) 0.001))

  (let loop ((ts ts) (prev #f) (out '()))
    (cond ((null? ts) (reverse out))
          (else (let ((now (pred (car ts))))

                        (if (and now (not prev)) (cons (car ts) out) out)))))))

(let loop ((i 0))
  (if (< i (vector-length sprites))
    (begin (display (vector-ref sprites i)) (loop (+ i 1)))
    (newline)))

(define fb (vector 'a 'b 'c))
(define snap (vector-copy fb))
(vector-set! fb 0 'X)
(display (list 'fb fb 'snap snap))
(newline)

(define (finite-impulse? dvx dvy)
  ;; Reject NaN/Infinity impulses — they poison entity velocity forever.
  (and (number? dvx) (number? dvy)
       (not (= dvx (+ dvx 1e300)))    ; Infinity check
       (not (= dvy (+ dvy 1e300)))))
(finite-impulse? 5 -20)

(define (contraction-argument)
  ;; PBD projection is non-expansive: after each solve step, residual r' ≤ r.
  ;; Under repeated application, residual → 0 (contraction mapping).
  (list ':operator 'PBD-projection
        ':property 'non-expansive
        ':fixed-point 'constraint-manifold))
(contraction-argument)

(define (nn-graph kinds)
  ;; Build the directed nearest-neighbor graph over kinds — every node points to its closest other-kind neighbor.
  (map (lambda (k)
         (map (lambda (e) (list e '-> (world/nearest e k)))
              (world/find k)))
       kinds))
(nn-graph '(orc player))

(define (projection-signature pitch)
  ;; Projection is a linear map: world coord w -> screen coord w/pitch.
  ;; Verify the pitch parameter divides positions uniformly.
  (list ':pitch pitch ':scale (/ 1 pitch) ':world->screen 'linear))
(projection-signature 2)

(define (repulsive-potential id cx cy strength)
  ;; Repel = -∇U where U = +k/r (positive potential, softened at origin).
  ;; Sign flips compared to attract; direction reverses; magnitude same profile.
  (list ':center (list cx cy) ':strength strength
        ':potential 'positive-inverse-r
        ':gradient 'outward-radial))
(repulsive-potential 'body 100 100 40)

(define (undo-redo-model)
  ;; snapshot + restore = event-sourced undo stack.
  ;; Each snapshot is an event; restore rewinds the aggregate to that event.
  (list ':pattern 'event-sourcing
        ':operation 'rewind-to-event
        ':id-preserved 'yes))
(undo-redo-model)

;; honest-null: hashing is content-addressing (like a Merkle root over entity state). It has no algebra beyond distributional properties — you cannot 'add' or 'multiply' two hashes meaningfully. The domain properties (determinism, low collision) are engineering guarantees, not equations.

(define (grid-cloth cols rows spacing stiff)
  ;; 2D constraint graph → cloth simulation.
  ;; Horizontal links: (i,j)-(i+1,j); vertical links: (i,j)-(i,j+1).
  (list ':horizontal (* rows (- cols 1))
        ':vertical (* cols (- rows 1))
        ':total-constraints (+ (* rows (- cols 1)) (* cols (- rows 1)))
        ':stiffness stiff))
(grid-cloth 5 5 10 0.9)

(define (harmonic-motion-bound amp)
  ;; |amp · sin(θ)| ≤ amp for any θ, since sin ∈ [-1, 1].
  (list ':property 'bounded-oscillation
        ':max amp
        ':source 'sin-range))
(harmonic-motion-bound 0.5)

(define (restore-operator-view ctx)
  (let ((cam (world/tape-lcamera)))
    (if (equal? cam 'none)
      (next 'idle ctx)
      (begin
        (camera-snap! (car cam) (cadr cam))
        (camera-zoom-to (caddr cam))
        (next 'replay-ready (ctx-set 'viewport cam ctx))))))

(define (finite-wind? wx wy)
  ;; Reject NaN/Infinity — would poison every entity velocity.
  (and (number? wx) (number? wy)
       (< (abs wx) 1e6) (< (abs wy) 1e6)))
(finite-wind? 2 0)
